name: Run notebooks batch
description: Non-interactive launcher that executes notebooks and writes rendered notebooks to the output-data connector.

args: set -euxo pipefail; cd /home/renku/work; mkdir -p output-data/executed-notebooks; echo 'Searching for notebooks...'; find renku-demo-air-quality-analysis -path '*/.ipynb_checkpoints/*' -prune -o -name '*.ipynb' -print; while IFS= read -r -d '' nb; do out="output-data/executed-notebooks/${nb#renku-demo-air-quality-analysis/}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"; echo "Executing $nb -> $out"; jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute "$nb" --output "/home/renku/work/$out" --ExecutePreprocessor.timeout=1200; done < <(find renku-demo-air-quality-analysis -path '*/.ipynb_checkpoints/*' -prune -o -name '*.ipynb' -print0)
